title: A Focused Survey of Generative AI-Based Music Therapy Systems: Recent Progress and Open Challenges
abstract_preview: Generative artificial intelligence (AI)-based music generation has the potential to create new opportunities for music therapy; however, integrated examinations of generative AI and music therapy remain limited. reviewer_notes: Survey linking generative AI to music therapy; strong music and ML with clear clinical bridge.

abstract_preview: Music recommendation systems are an essential part of modern music streaming services, allowing for personalized discovery of music. reviewer_notes: Music recommender cold-start and continuation with unusual quantum framing; speculative but on-topic and bridge-like.

title: From sound to source: Human and model recognition of environmental sounds
abstract_preview: Our ability to recognize sound sources in the world is critical to daily life, but is not well documented or understood in computational terms. We developed a large-scale behavioral benchmark of human environmental sound recognition, built stimulus-computable models of sound recognition, and used the benchmark to compare models to humans. The behavioral b...
reviewer_notes: Strong audio cognition and recognition benchmark; adjacent audio ML but not core music discovery.

title: Sound and music biases in deep music transcription models: a systematic analysis
abstract_preview: Automatic Music Transcription (AMT)-the task of converting music audio into note representations - has seen rapid progress, driven largely by deep learning systems. reviewer_notes: Strong AMT bias and evaluation angle; core MIR not a negative; bridge partial because mostly in-domain methodology.

title: MusReco: A New Transformer-Enhanced Paradigm of Music Recommendation
abstract_preview: With the rapid development of the Internet and information technology, the availability of music resources has experienced significant growth. reviewer_notes: On-target music recommendation but abstract reads generic and conventional; relevant but unlikely surprising.

title: Deep Learning-Based Emotion Recognition from Instrumental Hindi Music Signal
abstract_preview: Music Emotion Recognition (MER) is an important research area within Music Information Retrieval that focuses on automatically identifying emotional characteristics conveyed by music. Although deep learning approaches have shown promising performance, most existing studies rely heavily on vocal or lyrical information and are largely based on Western music...
reviewer_notes: Direct MER on instrumental Hindi music; useful underrepresented context; bridge partial as mostly core MIR MER.
